title: Practical setups people actually use
question: Across the setups a person would realistically choose, which coordination shape produces better accepted work on the same scenarios under the same external grading?
establishes: A like-for-like comparison of four realistic setups on identical tasks with identical grading. It does not isolate the worker model: the setups deliberately differ in more than one way.

environment.notes: Local operator machine, offline. Node 22+ and Git only; no provider calls are made by the bench. Record the actual machine, tool versions and network posture before starting.
